headline: Ye’s Chicago homecoming brought in $29.8 MILLION across just two sold-out nights 🤯🔥 Acco
body: Ye’s Chicago homecoming brought in $29.8 MILLION across just two sold-out nights 🤯🔥 According to Pollstar’s official box office report, the shows sold a combined 129,562 tickets, with Friday night alone grossing $15.76 million. That Friday performance set a new record for the highest single-day concert gross in Soldier Field history. Pollstar also reported that it appears to be the highest-grossing single hip-hop concert ever. 🏟️ Nearly $30 million in ticket sales from two nights in his hometown… Chicago showed up for Ye 👏 📸:

source_caption_text:
Ye’s Chicago homecoming brought in $29.8 MILLION across just two sold-out nights 🤯🔥

According to Pollstar’s official box office report, the shows sold a combined 129,562 tickets, with Friday night alone grossing $15.76 million.

That Friday performance set a new record for the highest single-day concert gross in Soldier Field history. Pollstar also reported that it appears to be the highest-grossing single hip-hop concert ever. 🏟️

Nearly $30 million in ticket sales from two nights in his hometown… Chicago showed up for Ye 👏
